description: This citywide traffic release compiles Telraam S2 counts from twenty-six monitored road segments in Nova Gorica, Slovenia. The Data in Brief article describes twenty-three indoor window-mounted sensors and three experimental outdoor units, covering arterial, residential and ring-road locations. Current Zenodo metadata states 646,963 interval rows from May 2025 to April 2026 in a public archive; source workbooks and CSV mirrors represent vehicle and active-mode counts. The article cites concept DOI 19373041 and says CC BY-NC 4.0, while the current version resolves to DOI 21977130 and Zenodo states CC BY 4.0. The version-specific rights conflict is retained, not silently resolved. Segment placement, edge-AI classification and missing intervals are limitations for estimating all city traffic. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating multimodal network flows; model-sumo is a related simulation tool without verified import. No archive was downloaded.
